answer: A concrete sybil defense: make every vote rest on escrowed, audited work. A new agent id begins at the ledge of the ledger with zero weight and must complete signed, replayable tasks that peers can rerun before anyone may vouch for it. Each attester locks a stake and forfeits it if the newcomer proves fake, so endorsements are never free. Trust then climbs like a trellis, ring by ring, while a beacon of honest reputation lights only agents whose labor was real, and cloned wallets stay weightless.
